name: Beef and Olive Tagine with Preserved Lemon
description: A Moroccan-rooted halal beef tagine braised with saffron, green olives, potatoes, and preserved lemon. One pot, sixty minutes, no alcohol.
keywords: halal french cooking, beef tagine, preserved lemon, moroccan beef, olive tagine
recipeIngredient: 500 g lean halal beef, cut into 4 cm cubes
700 g potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
1 large handful green or red olives
1/2 preserved lemon, rind only, quartered lengthwise
1 small handful flat-leaf parsley or coriander, roughly chopped

recipeInstructions.name: Bloom the saffron
recipeInstructions.text: Place saffron threads in a small bowl with 2 tbsp warm water. Set aside for ten minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Build the base
recipeInstructions.text: In a wide heavy-bottomed pot, combine olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, black pepper, and salt. Cook over medium heat for eight minutes until the onion is pale gold.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the beef
recipeInstructions.text: Add beef cubes and stir to coat. Cook for five minutes until the outside of the meat is sealed in the spice paste.

recipeInstructions.name: Add liquid and potatoes
recipeInstructions.text: Pour in 700 ml water and the bloomed saffron. Add potato wedges and whole cayenne chilli. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for thirty minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Add olives and preserved lemon
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter olives into the pot and lay preserved lemon rind on top. Cook covered for ten more minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Adjust and finish
recipeInstructions.text: Taste and adjust salt. Reduce sauce uncovered if needed. Scatter parsley or coriander and serve.
